points.what: APAC orders rose 5.4% WoW, contributing +17 orders, 141.7% of the week's net order change.
points.so_what: APAC was the main source of the week's order growth.

points.what: North America orders fell 9.9% WoW, contributing -18 orders, -150% of the week's net change.
points.so_what: North America's decline offset most of APAC's gain, which is why total orders rose only 1.6% WoW.

points.what: Search orders rose 3.4% WoW, contributing +17 orders, while Facebook fell 24.1% WoW, contributing -14 orders.
points.so_what: Search's gain had to absorb Facebook's pullback for total orders to grow at all this week.

points.what: AOV rose to $86.1, up 1.1% WoW and 3.2% YoY, while orders grew only 1.6% WoW but revenue grew 6.1% WoW.
points.so_what: This week's revenue growth came from both more orders and bigger baskets, not orders alone.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 2.8 pp WoW and 4.2 pp YoY to 12.7%, a notable improvement.
points.so_what: Fewer cancelled orders this week reduces revenue lost to cancellations, supporting the week's revenue gain.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 16 Feb fell to 9.0%, down 1.0 pp WoW and 2.3 pp YoY, a notable improvement.
points.so_what: A lower share of that week's orders being returned is a positive signal on order quality.

points.what: New signups rose to 260, up 12.6% WoW and 15.6% YoY, while orders grew 59.1% YoY.
points.so_what: New customer signups are growing much slower than orders on a year-on-year basis.

summary.headline: Orders (88.7% of target) and revenue (94.7% of target) both finished behind target; QTD and YTD revenue are also behind at 92.0% attainment.

points.what: Orders reached 743, 88.7% of target with a gap of -95 orders, while revenue reached $55,878, 94.7% of target with a gap of -$3,107.
points.so_what: Both weekly targets were missed, keeping the quarter behind target.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 92.0% with a gap of -$47,452 and only 3 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: The remaining weeks need to close this gap for the quarter to hit target.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 2.8 pp WoW to 12.7% and the 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 16 Feb fell 1.0 pp WoW to 9.0%, both notable improvements.
points.so_what: Order quality improved even as the week missed its revenue and order targets.

points.what: New signups rose 12.6% WoW to 260, a notable increase, while orders rose only 1.6% WoW.
points.so_what: Signup growth outpaced order growth this week, the opposite of the year-on-year pattern where orders grew faster.
